research_question: Can an SDN defense system safely translate uncertain detection results into proportionate, explainable, and reversible mitigation actions while adapting to changes in its learned environment?

stage6.graph_construction: not scientifically supported by current benchmark/runtime contracts

read_only_capabilities.typed_action_expiry_and_rollback_contrac: DecisionRecord expiry and MitigationPort apply/rollback interfaces only
read_only_capabilities.flow_identity: optional FlowRecord match fields; incomplete identity must fail closed
read_only_capabilities.asset_importance: unavailable; fixed Mininet protected-flow config only

threshold_calibration.score: binary RF p_attack; score definition and model ID recorded
threshold_calibration.score_group_ties: indivisible; choose the lowest threshold meeting the benign action-rate upper bound
threshold_calibration.unattainable_operating_point: use conservative no-action boundary and report unattainable

risk_policy.LOW: BENIGN, below tau_rate, shift alone, or missing/stale/unscoped evidence -> MONITOR
risk_policy.MEDIUM: attack score >= tau_rate without HIGH evidence, or repeated scoped UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN -> RATE_LIMIT if verified else MONITOR
risk_policy.HIGH: attack score >= tau_quarantine plus independent corroborator, or >= tau_block without VERY_HIGH evidence -> QUARANTINE if exact scope supported else MONITOR
risk_policy.VERY_HIGH: attack score >= tau_block plus same-scope persistence in >=2 consecutive 2-second observations and independent corroboration, no protected-flow match -> exact-scope BLOCK
risk_policy.uncertain_maximum: MEDIUM; RATE_LIMIT only with repeated scoped evidence; otherwise MONITOR
risk_policy.psi_alone_action: MONITOR; PSI may enter adaptation gate only
risk_policy.protected_flow: h1<->h3 is never disrupted; matching protected flow forces MONITOR

policies.A_always_block: ATTACK -> immediate exact-scope BLOCK; all other states MONITOR; fixed TTL applies
policies.B_confidence: below tau_rate MONITOR; tau_rate..tau_quarantine RATE_LIMIT; tau_quarantine..tau_block QUARANTINE; >=tau_block BLOCK; no numeric attack score -> MONITOR
policies.C_risk_aware: frozen risk_policy; fixed TTL and expiry; no extension
policies.D_risk_aware_reversible: same risk decision as C plus midpoint re-evaluation, immediate rollback on changed/stale evidence, at most one conditional extension

mitigation_lifecycle.install_failure: log/alert; no escalation or scope broadening
mitigation_lifecycle.rollback_failure: one exact-cookie delete retry, log/alert, stop scenario, clean Mininet; never flush unrelated flows
mitigation_lifecycle.rate_limit_prerequisite: verify OVS meter support and exact meter removal; otherwise MONITOR

adaptation_gate.shift_signal: frozen Stage 5F PSI >=0.20 on >=5/77 features; source/window level only
adaptation_gate.behavior_evidence: after one-window label release: macro F1 decline >0.05 or benign FPR increase >0.02 versus initial validation, OR validation-calibrated UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN rate control-limit breach
adaptation_gate.label_delay: one window; current-window labels cannot trigger or fit; W4 labels evaluation-only
adaptation_gate.candidate_rollback: reject if anchor macro F1 declines >0.05 or anchor benign FPR increases >0.02 versus initial model
adaptation_gate.candidate_promotion: requires held-out matured-data validation objective improvement under frozen benign-FPR constraint and anchor pass

evaluation.offline: new Stage 7 replay of frozen Stage 5D CSE-SFH-A/B memberships and RF config; output only under experiments/stage7; recompute row-level scores; same rows/seeds across policies
evaluation.mininet: only after feature-parity and flow-correlation gate; until then adapter lifecycle safety only, with explicit test decisions

metrics.unavailable_metrics: report unavailable; do not infer or fabricate
metrics.utility: multi-objective cost table/Pareto comparison; no scalar weights selected after observing final outcomes
